decisions.reason: The offshore vessel management unit has not maintained a web presence since 2019, indicating performance below aspirations and prompting search for alternative resource uses.
Crew and corporate travel management shows limited market visibility and likely falls short of comparable service aspirations, though slack may briefly delay exit.
The online vessel information portal is peripheral to core warehousing and transportation support, and its absence from the website signals low adoption below aspiration.
The mobile vessel performance app has not established traction and is likely underperforming relative to aspirations, leading management to consider reallocating slack resources.
